chosen_titles.rationale: WV's Ethics Act (W. Va. Code Ch. 6B) houses the lobbyist registration, reporting, and disclosure regime under 'Public Officers and Employees'.

notes: Single regime in WV; no parallel executive/legislative split. Chapter 6B (Public Officers and Employees) contains the Ethics Act, which includes the lobbying-disclosure provisions per prior 2010 vintage (Ch. 6B Art. 3 = §§ 6B-3-1 et seq.).
